messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (37.2 s) ===
[0.0-3.0] JULIANA (Cold, Commanding): "You have no authority here. Leave."
[3.4-7.7] SCREEN: Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.
[3.8-6.7] GERALD (Furious, Threatening): "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
[6.8-7.7] GERALD (Spiteful, Boastful): "And your husband?"
[7.7-12.2] SCREEN: Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.
[7.7-9.4] GERALD (Snarl): "Where is that beggar husband?"
[8.2-13.7] ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
[12.2-13.7] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
[13.7-16.7] SCREEN: Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
[14.4-15.7] SOUND_FX: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
[16.7-19.2] SCREEN: Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
[19.2-21.7] SCREEN: Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
[19.7-22.2] ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
[21.7-26.2] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.
[24.7-26.7] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Urgent, Annoyed): "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
[26.8-28.2] GERALD (Trembling, Trying to Save Face): "What are you staring at?"
[28.2-29.7] ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
[28.3-29.6] GERALD (Nervous, Hurried): "We are leaving."
[29.7-32.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.
[30.2-32.0] ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN (Outraged, Flustered): "Leaving? Gerald!"
[32.0-34.7] ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
[33.2-34.2] SOUND_FX: Carriage door slamming shut.
[34.2-37.2] SCREEN: Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.
